We got search results. The first entry seems to be a Diels-Alder template: retro_smarts_template shows product to reactants? It shows [C;D1;H3:1]-[#8:2]-[C:3](=[O... etc. The mapped_rxn shows reactants: [CH2:6]=[CH:7][CH:8]=[CH2:9] (a diene) and [CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1=[CH:10][C:11](=[O:12])[CH2:13]1 (a dienophile). The product is the target. So applying this template to target should give those two precursors.

Thus we need to apply this template to the target molecule to get precursors. We have template ID? Not given. We have template hash but need ID. The search result includes reaction_id and template_hash but not template_id. Possibly we can use apply_template with template_id? We need template ID. Maybe the template ID is the reaction_id? Not sure. Could use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching? But we need to apply.

Maybe the tool get_template can retrieve by ID if we know ID. The search result didn't give template ID. Could be "template_1914385"? Not sure. The reaction_id is 1914385. Might be template ID same as reaction_id? Let's try apply_template with that ID.
